name: Granny Wick
dialog: Tamsin! The Mirewell has gone dark, and the frogs won't sing.
Something nests in the grotto south-east of the village.
Take my old driftwood sword. Swing it with ATTACK.

lines: The well sings again. You did that, little lantern.
Cracked rock? Pell sells bomb bags, if you find bombs first.
Pits too wide? Look for a hook post.
